==Overview== 
[[File:Elemental Type Chart.png|100px|thumb|left|Elemental type chart.]] The Water type is one of the five elemental types found in Clash of Critters.

[[Critters]] and [[Zobos]] of the Water type are weak to [[Lightning]].

They are also super effective against [[Fire]].
